tagline: You can now use %uv init, %uv add, and %uv sync in serverless notebooks running environment version 5 or above to create a Python project, add dependencies, and sync its environment.
what_it_does: You can now use %uv init, %uv add, and %uv sync in serverless notebooks running environment version 5 or above to create a Python project, add dependencies, and sync its environment. Notebook scoped libraries let you create, modify, save, reuse, and share custom Python environments that are specific to a notebook. When you install a notebook scoped library, only the current notebook and any jobs associated with that notebook have access to that library.
why_it_matters: Faster installs with %uv pip note %uv pip is only available on serverless notebooks running environment version 5 or above.
